visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens in a bedroom with warm indoor lighting. A woman in a white cardigan pulls a patterned white and beige blanket over herself and a man wearing a dark sweatshirt. They are lying on a large wooden headboard bed. The woman looks at the man and smiles while pulling the blanket up to their chests. (2) A closer shot shows the woman lying on her side, resting her head on a pillow. She looks towards the man, who is lying on his back with eyes closed. Her facial expression is one of curiosity as she appears to be whispering something to him. (3) Scene cuts to a living room. The couple is sitting on a light-colored fabric sofa. The man is holding a dark remote in his hand. The woman suddenly flinches and covers her mouth with a black pillow, looking towards the camera with wide eyes as if watching something scary. The man puts his arm around her shoulders. (4) A close-up focus on the woman's face as she huddles against the man's chest, looking terrified. The man maintains a neutral, calm expression, looking forward towards the off-screen source. (5) Back to a medium shot on the sofa. The woman leans back, looking relieved and talking, while the man appears to have fallen asleep instantly with his head tilted back against the sofa. (6) Scene cuts back to the bedroom. The woman is lying alone on her stomach, holding a gold-colored smartphone and scrolling through a messaging app with her thumbs. (7) A direct close-up of the smartphone screen showing a chat interface with Traditional Chinese text bubbles and a keyboard at the bottom. (8) The phone screen shows a final message appearing and a sticker of a sleeping cartoon face with 'ZZZ' bubbles. The woman's hand is seen tapping the screen as the video concludes.

The video uses exaggerated scenarios and contrasting emotional reactions between the couple to create comedic effect.
